Effective_Date            ORDER BY  medicaid_number, ASSIST_CATEGORY, Effective_Date',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ENRLFLConsultecMonthly
ENRLFLConsultecMonthly sort(asc(MEDICAID_NUMBER, false),asc(ASSIST_CATEGORY, false),asc(Effective_Date, false)) ~> RemoveDuplicates
RemoveDuplicates sink(input(
		Effective_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Assist_Category as string,
		Medicaid_Number as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Effective_Date,
		Assist_Category = ASSIST_CATEGORY,
		Medicaid_Number = MEDICAID_NUMBER)) ~> DXFLConsultecMonthly
